digest.component_or_area: route reconciler differ/apply core via Backend port dependency injection
propositions: Reconciler core modules (outbound_differ, inbound_differ, apply_inbound) directly import vendor-specific MAPPER functions instead of receiving them via Backend port dependency injection.
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK is defined in adapters/jira/outbound_fields instead of being single-sourced in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py.
The injected outbound_mapper and inbound_mapper parameters are threaded through run_differs and used by differ compute phases to route vendor mapper calls through the Backend port abstraction.

Module-level imports of _map_local_to_jira_fields and _map_jira_to_local_fields are eliminated from differ modules; mappers are injected via Backend-port seam with lazy resolution via select_backend for internal-helper paths.
AST assertions in test_backend_neutrality.py verify that injected mappers are actually used and not bypassed, and that no direct vendor MAPPER entrypoint imports remain in core differ modules.
